title: Fintastic | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Side Gated Comm with Beach Access- Fintastic by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Fintastic by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 91 Majestica Circle Details: Fintastic is an ideal place to relax and soak in the peaceful ambiance of Seagrove Beach. The sunsets will be something you remember for a lifetime. This perfect beach house retreat is located South of 30A just a few homes back from the beautiful white sands of the Emerald Coast. The private gated community of Majestica Beach is perfectly situated centrally along 30A. Fintastic offers room for everyone to enjoy the sanctuary of their private accommodations or gather on the main floor with its spacious living area for dinners and games. The community pool is so close you can simply open the door and walk across the little one-way quiet street. A large front porch is located across from the beautiful community pool and guests also enjoy private beach access. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: 200 Feet (1 Minute Walk); Private Community Beach Access - Private, Gated Community South of 30A - Community Pool Steps Away - 4 Parking Spaces - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service - 3 Spacious Porches - 2 Seasonal Beach Set Ups March-October (2 Umbrellas and 4 Beach Chairs) Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 6 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths First Floor: - Guest Room 1: Queen Bed, Shared Bath with Shower - Great Room / Dining Room / Kitchen / Large Porch Second Floor: - Guest Room 2: King Bed, Private Bath - Guest Room 3: Queen Bed, Private Bath - Guest Room 4: Queen Bed, Jack and Jill Bath with Shower - Guest Room 5: Bunk Room (Twin/Twin) Jack and Jill Bath with Shower -Laundry Third Floor: - Guest Room 6: King Bed, Private Bath with Soaking Tub and Shower - Full Size Sleeper, Seating Area, Beverage Center, Television Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
